# Decision Rain Library Project

> Turn interesting links into decision notes with Raindrop and an AI assistant.

Canonical page: https://xxyoudeadpunkxx.github.io/decision-rain-library-project/
Repository: https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/decision-rain-library-project
License: CC BY-SA 4.0

## What this is

Decision Rain Library Project is a lightweight decision-library template for people who save repos, tools, docs, articles, products, directories, and research sparks before they know what is worth adopting.

The project uses Raindrop as the saved-link backend and an AI assistant as a review helper. The assistant may preserve, inspect, research, and propose; the operator decides final placement, tags, promotion, archive, and taxonomy changes.

## Core loop

1. Save the original link to 00_INBOX.
2. Inspect the page, repo, docs, or available evidence.
3. Produce a short review with verdict, next step, claim, evidence, authority, confidence state, risk, and practical fit.
4. Operator validates the judgment.
5. Move the item to 10_REVIEW, 20_LIBRARY, or 90_ARCHIVE.

## Public surface

This GitHub Pages artifact is a single human-facing project overview page plus machine-readable discovery files. It is not the private Raindrop corpus.

## Safe public material

- schema and rules
- blank templates
- synthetic examples
- placeholder SYSTEM URLs
- public documentation explaining the operating model

## Unsafe material

- private Raindrop exports
- personal saved links with notes
- credentials, connector tokens, cookies, or account identifiers
- assistant transcripts containing private decisions
